Core Words

Common Words groups everyday vocabulary by topic; this page ranks words by how often Kazakh uses them. We counted about 2.2 million words (0.4 million of movie subtitles, 1.8 million of news and Wikipedia) and merged word forms, so мен, менің and маған count once. These 300 words make up 64% of the subtitles and 47% of the news and Wikipedia text (the top 100 make up 49% and 34%, the top 200 make up 59% and 42%). Verbs are shown in dictionary form (ending in -у), and the last column lists the forms that appear.
